query: SELECT bookmark.topic_id,bookmark.through_activity, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM board_activity activity WHERE activity.activity_sequence=bookmark.through_activity AND activity.topic_id=bookmark.topic_id AND activity.kind='mainMessageCreated') AS valid_scope FROM topic_read_bookmarks bookmark JOIN board_topics topic ON topic.topic_id=bookmark.topic_id JOIN project_boards board ON board.board_id=topic.board_id WHERE bookmark.reader_key=? AND board.project_id=?
